name: Textarea
description: A multi-line text field: a real `<textarea>`, styled by Box props. `rows` is how tall it starts, `height` how tall it stays, and `fieldSizing="content"` lets it grow as it is typed into.

props.name: name
props.description: What the field submits under, and what a `<label htmlFor>` of your own would point at.

props.name: props
props.description: Attributes for the `<textarea>` itself — an `id`, an `aria-label`, `autoComplete`, `wrap`.

props.name: onInput
props.description: Fires on every keystroke. `onChange` is React's alias for the same event.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires on every keystroke too — React's `onChange` is the DOM's `input`, not its `change`.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: A string is the attribute; an object is `::placeholder` styles. Neither one names the field.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Pair it with `onChange`, or the field cannot be typed into.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value it starts with when the field owns its own state.

props.name: rows
props.description: How many lines tall it starts. `height` is the Box prop for the size it stays.

props.name: cols
props.description: How many characters wide it starts — `width` is the prop to reach for instead.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus it on mount. One per page at most — a stolen focus is a lost place in the document.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The most characters the field accepts. The browser both enforces and announces it.

props.name: minLength
props.description: The fewest characters that count as valid. Checked when the form is submitted.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Editable to nobody, but still focusable, still read out and still submitted.

props.name: required
props.description: The form will not submit while it is empty, and a screen reader says so.

keyboard.action: Focuses the field, and Tab again leaves it: Tab never inserts a tab character.
Inserts a line break rather than submitting the form around it.

a11y: Nothing here names the field. A `placeholder` is not a name — it disappears on the first keystroke — so pair it with a `<label htmlFor>` of your own, or pass `props={{ 'aria-label': … }}`.
`maxLength` is announced as well as enforced, so a limit hit by a screen-reader user is not a silent one.
